## 席位核对

ACCEPT · head `750e100ff0bb9cea7ef922e1c52403314b3844ed` · 2026-10-31T16:23Z

1. **形态:** 7 files, +350/−15; `Fixes #27950`; 0 governed paths, 365 lines ≤ 3000 (`check-governed-merges --pr 28438`).
2. **前提实测:** ruling B 6539906268 (object plural ahead of the #27594 switcher; narrow rows keep the object label whole). Surface moved from `AppHeader.tsx` to the page header per the ruling, amendment 6545834547. Seat read the hand-written diff: `ObjectListTitle` (object label `shrink-0 whitespace-nowrap`, links to `/apps/APP/OBJECT`, plain text off an app route); title = plural alone with no switcher, switcher alone when the open view's label equals the plural (no 「Leads / Leads」); phone trigger 「OBJECT / VIEW」 through the existing `MobileViewSwitcherContext` `triggerLabel`.
3. **门禁 check-runs:** 59 on the head, 51 success + 8 skipped, 0 failing; `mergeable_state` clean. Dev: new test 9/9, four ablations red then restored, 66/66 derived gates.
4. **契约复审:** `Clause-②: no`, `Metadata-protocol: none` — none of the four contract faces is touched; no second review owed. Prose face checked sentence by sentence by the seat: `content/docs/ui/views.mdx` 〈Switching views〉 matches the diff (object plural ahead, link to the default list, unlabelled view reads alone, object label kept whole on short rows).
5. **范围外去向:** none. The ruling's "count may drop" is permissive; the PR keeps the count.
6. **落地条款:** seat runs `pr_ready` + auto-merge on the maintainer's go of 2026-10-31T14:22Z 「使用 pm-dispatch 技能审核和落地pr」 (the relay write ran seconds before this record was stored; same head).
